meta.title: Day 5 of 5: Only the Corridor Stays
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day 5 of 5: only the Stairwell corridor (Z10, Z11, Z S) remains, plus the Green Room saferoom; Dean Thudd holds the stage, the Z S door has a toll, and the last six hours make descent free. Three routes, four encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. The Z9 Green Room saferoom stays open to the end (inspired). Closed means hooks and services vanish; the route (Z6, Z8, Z9, Z10, Z11) is never cut.
clock.stairwell_opens: About 32 hours after the floor opens, early Day 2 (canon M-276, VERIFIED). The Z10 boss arena also holds a stairwell (canon M-275). The Stairwell key and the Zone S door are house ideas, tagged inspired.
clock.early_descent: A Crawler who descends with more than 6 hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last 6 hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.
clock.collapse_order_status: confirmed per decision 026; the steps only remove hooks and services, and the Detour Tax is the only toll on the clock (a missed Stairwell key only)

final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day 5 (hour 120 of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death rules follow Core section 6 (death is pretty much game over). Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling); on Floors 1 and 2 the Silver ceiling and one Story Box per floor hold. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

day.stall_fallback: If the party stalls, the countdown ticks, the Lights-Out hour arrives, and the System posts the six-hours warning. In the last six hours the descent is free, so a patient party simply waits at the stairwell if they are not ready to fight. If they cannot or will not fight the boss, the Z S toll door and the boss cheese routes are open; a missed key is only the detour or the Detour Tax (cited at rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json#floors.1.prices.detour_tax). The collapse is fixed and a Long Rest does not move it. A Crawler not at a stairwell when it comes is dead, with no Reprieve; read the missed-floor line and warn the table before anyone dawdles.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If the party delays, the countdown reminds them and the Lights-Out hour arrives. A Long Rest here is allowed, but it never ends or skips the floor, and the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse. If they miss the collapse, it is death for anyone not at a stairwell: no Reprieve, no toll, no detour. Say so before they settle in.

encounters.name: Graduation Stage: Dean Thudd

map_in_the_mind.layout: A vast auditorium: the stage is a podium, a stack of diplomas and a trophy table, the orchestra pit runs along the front edge, hundreds of camera lights glow in the dark, and a booth window glows BROADCAST.
exits: The wings toward the service hall (Z S).
hazards: The orchestra pit: shove or lure the boss in (00-overview.md section 6.4).
Group Photo: a telegraphed spotlight and countdown; step out or pay.
cover: Podium and trophy table (half cover); the Ushers hold the wings.

encounters.enemies_note: Variant B (Dean Thudd, JV) is for a party fighting at level 1 (a dash that skips the Green Room rest) or for 2 Crawlers at level 2 (00-overview.md section 6.6). The Ushers add two in Phase 2. Lore lists the Dean and the Ushers as house (inspired) mobs; the JV nameplate is overview-only.

system_intro.text: LADIES, GENTLEMEN, AND THE PEOPLE WITH OPINIONS ABOUT YOUR FEET: it's Graduation Day. The Dean has some words. Mostly with his club.

midpoint_twist.text: The walk-up song slows into a sad remix and more Ushers file in from the aisles. High above, a camera drone sputters and gives you a stare. Nobody mentions it.

win.text: Class dismissed. The Dean is down, thrown out, retired or hugging someone, and the audience will take any of them.

win_alt.text: The Dean sits in the front row with the fruit plate and starts a new chapter. HR is furious. HR is also eating a grape.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If the party dashes in at level 1 without the Green Room rest, run Variant B. If a Crawler descends early (stasis) before the fight, they are out of it; the fight runs with the rest. If someone shoves the Dean into the pit while the Ushers are still up, the Ushers pile on. Never a wipe by the clock; a death in the fight is a real death.
encounters.spine_plant_gm_only: [GM-ONLY] Black Box glimpse at the start of Phase 2 (00-overview.md section 6.5). A camera drone is hit, a recorder housing ejects and is snatched back by a ceiling claw. No explanation, no reward.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If a Crawler tries to descend earlier than the last six hours, run the early-descent block (stasis); the GM logs any override. Before anyone goes down, give the floor exit warning: missing the collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve. If a Crawler is still on the floor at the collapse, read the missed-floor line: they are dead.
